name: Tgi Infrastructures Ltd
summary: Tgi Infrastructures Ltd, along with its subsidiary, operates in Israel, specializing in the manufacturing, processing, and distribution of mechanical components made from aluminum and magnesium for the automotive industry. Its product range encompasses various engine parts, including oil sumps, valve covers, sealing closures, transmission assembly parts, gears, and steering rod elements, among other related items. Founded in 1993 and headquartered in Afula, Israel, the company was formerly named Tadir-Gan (Precision Products) 1993 Ltd before rebranding as Tgi Infrastructures Ltd in March 2022.
